patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I played ranked for 14 hours and now I've got a runny nose, sore throat, and feel gross. No fever, breathing is fine—I just need someone to say it isn't serious.
presentation.triageNote: 26-year-old male with two days of runny nose, sore throat, and malaise. He is afebrile, breathing comfortably, and has a normal examination; the presentation is consistent with an uncomplicated viral upper respiratory illness.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because a well-appearing patient with an uncomplicated viral upper-respiratory pattern is not expected to require emergency resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has two days of rhinorrhea, sore throat, and malaise, with normal vital signs, comfortable breathing, and a reassuring examination.
clinical.acuityReason: There are no findings suggesting airway compromise, pneumonia, sepsis, dehydration, or another urgent process.
keyFindings: Two days of runny nose and sore throat
teachingPoints: Antibiotics do not treat an uncomplicated viral upper-respiratory illness.
Return precautions should cover breathing difficulty, dehydration, persistent high fever, confusion, or significant worsening.

possibleDiagnoses: Early influenza or COVID-like viral illness
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Reassurance, fluids, rest, oral symptom treatment, and return precautions would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding a tissue to his nose, a bit sheepish
signs: holding a tissue to the nose
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 26-year-old man in a hoodie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, holding a tissue to his nose, looking a bit sheepish. Expression: sniffly but otherwise fine and a little embarrassed. Clearly visible: a tissue held to the nose; he otherwise looks healthy. No text, no logos.
